# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change in plain language.

## Contribution Type

- [ ] Definition or terminology
- [ ] Principle or doctrine
- [ ] Failure pattern
- [ ] Architecture pattern
- [ ] Example
- [ ] Diagram
- [ ] RFC
- [ ] Editorial clarity

## Operational Rationale

Explain the operational problem this change helps clarify.

## Files Updated

List the main files changed.

## Review Notes

Note any terminology, scope, or consistency questions reviewers should check.

## Checklist

- [ ] Uses Canadian English spelling.
- [ ] Avoids hype, vendor promotion, and fear-based AI narratives.
- [ ] Avoids private, client, commercial, or confidential material.
- [ ] Uses "Because Drift Happens" in full before any abbreviation.
- [ ] Updates related glossary, reading-map, or example files if needed.
